0022600092.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Phoenix Suns visit the Portland Trail Blazers, and Phoenix will be without Mark Williams, who is out after shoulder surgery, while Portland is missing Shaedon Sharpe, who is out following knee surgery. The Suns won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, but their most recent meeting, on February 22, 2026 in Phoenix, ended with a 92-77 loss. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Suns a 40% chance of winning.
